verdict.rationale: Semgrep is not itself an agent, so a first-party MCP server for connecting external agents is a fair axis, and evidence confirms one exists at docs.semgrep.dev/mcp. However, the evidence pack only shows the URL's existence via a probe with no detail on the tools/capabilities exposed or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of what MCP tools/resources are exposed, setup instructions, and independent/hands-on confirmation of usage.
